interface.name: Metallic
interface.description: Blends between a dielectric and metallic material model. At 0.0 the material consists of a diffuse or transmissive base layer, with a specular reflection layer on top. A value of 1.0 gives a fully specular reflection tinted with the base color, without diffuse reflection or transmission

interface.name: IOR
interface.description: Index of Refraction (IOR) for specular reflection and transmission. For most materials, the IOR is between 1.0 (vacuum and air) and 4.0 (germanium). The default value of 1.5 is a good approximation for glass

interface.name: Roughness Min
interface.description: Value of the first floating number input

interface.name: Roughness Max
interface.description: Value of the second floating number input

interface.name: Bump Distance
interface.description: Multiplier for the height value to control the overall distance for bump mapping

interface.name: Coat Weight
interface.description: Controls the intensity of the coat layer, both the reflection and the tinting. Typically should be zero or one for physically-based materials

interface.name: Sheen Weight
interface.description: Intensity of the sheen layer, which simulates very small fibers on the surface

interface.name: Emission Strength
interface.description: Strength of the emitted light. A value of 1.0 ensures that the object in the image has the exact same color as the Emission Color

interface.name: Alpha Min
interface.description: Value of the first floating number input

interface.name: Alpha Max
interface.description: Value of the second floating number input

interface.name: Subsurface Weight
interface.description: Blend between diffuse surface and subsurface scattering. Typically should be zero or one (either fully diffuse or subsurface)

interface.name: Subsurface Scale
interface.description: Scale factor of the subsurface scattering radius

interface.name: Hue
interface.description: Hue rotation offset, from 0 (-180°) to 1 (+180°). Note that 0 and 1 have the same result

interface.name: Saturation
interface.description: Value of 0 removes color from the image, making it black-and-white. A value greater than 1.0 increases saturation

interface.name: Value
interface.description: Value shift. 0 makes the color black, 1 keeps it the same, and higher values make it brighter
